title: Contaminated Water Signs
description: Explains biological, chemical, and physical contamination and the visual, smell, taste, and environmental clues that reveal it. Covers contamination after floods, earthquakes, storms, and industrial accidents, boil water advisories, home test kits, and which treatment fits each contaminant.
shortDescription: Sight, smell, and taste warnings, post-disaster risks, and boil advisories
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
